{{Quote|The Nightsisters chose the strongest of their slaves and force them to work the mines!|An [[Unidentified escaped prisoner|escaped Nightsister prisoner]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:aeNs">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|an escaped Nightsister slave|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
The '''Nightsister Forced Labor Camp''' was a labor camp of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:NFLC" /> They sent slaves to this camp to work in their [[Mine/Legends|mines]].<ref name="SWG:aeNs" /> These slaves were only [[Gender/Legends|males]].<ref name="SWG:NFLC" />

==History==
{{Quote|We're trapped down deep inside the mines, and the Nightsisters oversee everything we do.|An escaped Nightsister prisoner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:aeNs" />}}
[[File:Nightsister_Forced_Labor_Camp_1.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The entrance of the mine.]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a [[Unidentified escaped prisoner|prisoner]] escaped from the camp and made it to the [[Trade Outpost]] where he hoped to find someone that would help him free the other slaves.<ref name="SWG:aeNs" />

At some point, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] sent a traitor from his [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|organization]] to Dathomir to be enslaved by the Nightsisters.<ref name="SWG:BM">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Bruce McBrain"</ref> Later, in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Bruce McBrain]], an underling of Jabba, hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to search the Nightsister Forced Labor Camp in order to retrieve the destruction code sequences of a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] that were once owned by the traitor.<ref name="SWG:BM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nightsister Forced Labor Camp appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NFLC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
